race.comment: LIM'S TEIDE (2) resumes as the horse to beat after winning a Rockhampton trial and bringing a neat profile at around 1100m. Showed positive signs in his debut prep and is well placed to kick things off with a bang in the new colours. KEMAL (10) is the race-fit danger after being beaten a neck in a BM58 at Sunshine Coast despite racing wide throughout, and his current campaign has been building towards a win. RICKYTHESTEAMBOAT (7) has two BM58/BM65 runs that read well for this, especially after covering ground as favourite last time, though his 1100m record is the main reservation. SUJEED (4) was less effective here at the latest but his two runs prior were up to the mark. Worth another look.
